description: List the account's proxy services of every type — Residential Basic/Premium/Private, Mobile, Mobile V2, Datacenter (static or traffic-based), ISP, IPv6 — with plan type, bandwidth left, expiry, whitelisted IPs and the orderId to pass to generate_proxies.
